reviews.title: Be aware! - very hard to unsubscribe
reviews.text: Unsubscription is manual!! And they charged me multiple times each month!!
reviews.reply:
Dear User, hello there!

We are very sorry to hear that our app didn’t meet your expectations and that you had payment issues. We apologize for any confusion!
If you have received a bank payment notification on the website, it means that you have activated automatic renewal. You confirm the automatic subscription renewal during the first payment for the Premium Subscription or Compatibility Report along with the Premium Subscription.
We provide this information on our sales page, payment screen, and Subscription terms. Also, in the Subscription Terms, it is clearly stated how to cancel the website subscription.
Please get in touch with us at support.nebula@gen.tech, we will do our best to help you with this concern.
